edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “from among 8,300 confirmed cases”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “confirmed cases had reached 8,300 across seven provinces”.
On 2026-10-02, Al Jazeera reported “across seven provinces”; on 2026-10-06, PBS NewsHour reported “In Congo, where the outbreak has spread to seven provinces, conditions are difficult.”.

On 2026-10-02, Al Jazeera reported “The current outbreak, which is the DRC’s 17th”; on 2026-10-06, Al Jazeera reported “The current outbreak, which is the DRC’s 17th, has spread rapidly since it was officially declared on May 15.”.
On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “They show that 4,018 people have died”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “Figures released on Friday showed that the death toll has risen to 4,018”.

On 2026-10-06, Al Jazeera reported “The outbreak has claimed more than 4,000 lives, according to figures released by the government on Friday, and confirmed cases have reached 8,300 across seven provinces, making it the worst Ebola epidemic in the country’s history.”; on the same day, PBS NewsHour reported “At least 8,400 cases have been recorded, including more than 4,000 deaths, according to government data, making it the fastest-growing outbreak of the disease in history.”.
